item.title: ask_questions tool always returns skipped:true regardless of user input
item.body:
## Description

The `ask_questions` tool consistently returns `{"skipped":true}` in the function results WITHOUT presenting any UI to the user. The quick pick dialog never appears, and the tool immediately returns as if the user skipped the question.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Use the `ask_questions` tool with any question and options
2. Observe that no quick pick dialog appears
3. The function result immediately returns with `{"skipped":true}`

## Expected Behavior

1. A quick pick dialog should appear with the question and options
2. User can select an option or provide free text input
3. The function result should contain either:
   - `{"selected": ["Option Label"]}` when an option is selected
   - `{"freeText": "user input"}` when free text is provided
   - `{"skipped": true}` only when the user explicitly dismisses/skips the question (ESC key)

## Actual Behavior

No UI is presented to the user. The tool immediately returns:
```json
{"answers":{"Header":{"selected":[],"freeText":null,"skipped":true}}}
```

The user has no opportunity to interact with the question.

## Example Tool Call

```json
{
  "questions": [{
    "allowFreeformInput": false,
    "header": "Test",
    "options": [
      {"label": "Option A"},
      {"label": "Option B"}
    ],
    "question": "Can you select one of these options?"
  }]
}
```

## Environment

- OS: Windows
- VS Code: Insiders
- GitHub Copilot: Latest
- Date: February 1, 2026

## Impact

This makes the `ask_questions` tool completely non-functional, preventing agents from gathering user preferences or clarifying intent through structured questions. The tool documentation suggests it should present interactive UI, but no UI appears at all.
